Sourdough Bread.ingredients:
Ingredients: 1/2 cup butter(softened)
2 tablespoons sugar
1 tablespoon salt
1 cup starter
2 & 1/2 cups water
8 cups all purpose flour. Instructions: 1) Mix it all in the mixer for deveral minutes(10 is great).
2) The dough should pass the window pane test.
3) Allow to rise for 10-12 hours. Cover the top with a moist towel.
4) Shape the loaf into a your bread pan.
5) Let rise again for 2-4 hours or until doubled in size.
6) Bake at 375 for 45 minutes.. Notes: I half the recipe so I only make one loaf. This is all that fits in my kitchen aid.

Sourdough Pizza Dough.ingredients:
Ingredients: 1/2 cup starter
4 cups flour
1.5 cups water
2 teaspoons salt
2 tablespoons olive oil. Instructions: Morning of pizza night stick everything in a mixer and mix for several minutes. Cover and let sit for about 8 hours.Bake at 475 for 15 minutes with toppings (but sometimes it takes longer).. Notes: We normally do this for BBQ chicken and top it with shredded checken, mozzerella, BBQ sauce and onion

Brunch Scones.ingredients:
Ingredients: 1 & 3/4 cups flour
4 tsp baking powder
5 tbsp butter
5 tbsp sugar
2/3 cups milk
1/2 cup filling
1 egg yolk. Instructions: 1) Preheat oven to 400
2) Combine flour, baking powder, butter, and sugar to a fine crumble. 
3) Add milk and filling. Mix well but don't overmix. 
4) Grease baking sheet and form into balls.
5) Bake 12-15 minutes.. Notes: You can add less sugar for more savory scones. Use the egg yolk to brush the top of the scones before baking.
